build_note: Source-built from the pinned sdist with maturin 1.16.0 (--locked) and rustc 1.99.1 -C instrument-coverage, codegen-units=1, LTO off and release debug info; the floating rust-toolchain file is overridden by RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN. The official wheels compile the same crates with optimisation.
dependencies_note: No Python runtime dependencies. Rust crates sqlparser 0.61.0, pyo3 0.28 and pythonize 0.28 are compiled in from the sdist Cargo.lock. The fuzz entry point is an external one-file Python bridge, not Atheris.
parser_family: sqlparser-rs (Rust tokenizer and recursive-descent parser), shared with the Rust sqlparser path (0.64.0 there, 0.61.0 here); sqloxide's own pyo3 binding (src/lib.rs) only selects the dialect, calls Parser::parse_sql and pythonizes the AST
api: sqloxide.parse_sql(local SQL text decoded from UTF-8 bytes, dialect="generic") -> list of statement ASTs as Python dicts and lists; the harness walks Query/Select (projection, from, joins, selection, group_by), order_by, Function, Table, Value, Insert and Values nodes
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: LLVM source-range coverage of the source-built sqloxide extension: sqlparser 0.61.0 crate sources (the sqloxide src/lib.rs binding is required to execute and reported separately)
scope: One SQL statement from local text via sqloxide.parse_sql with the generic dialect; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. restore_ast, the relation/expression visitors, other dialects and the optimised wheel build are untested.
underlying_release: sqlparser 0.61.0 (crates.io, pinned by the sdist Cargo.lock; sqlparser-rs tokenizer and recursive-descent parser)
